segments.name: Shipbroking services
segments.description: Provides shipbroking services to oil companies, traders, shipowners and commercial managers in tanker markets.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as one operating segment and one reportable segment, consisting of the provision of shipbroking services.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay commissions earned on freight, time charter, demurrage and sale and purchase transactions, calculated as a fixed fee or a percentage of transaction value.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue is primarily derived from commissions earned on freight, time charter, demurrage and sale and purchase transactions.
